comparison.objective: Seal one drain while repeatedly plunging the other to clear a shared pipe, then restore the tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sealing and at least four reciprocating plunger strokes under maintained contact.
comparison.success_condition: Hold the stopper down, pump at least four times until drainage, return both tools to specified worktop locations, and return both arms.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual stabilization and repeated force, but tests hydraulic sealing and reciprocation; it has no impact fracture, coil retention, or free-fragment containment.
